subject.title: fix(ui): show run failures above composer

question: Should Gateway clients receive a source-reply final event followed by an error terminal event for the same run when assistant output exists but the run also fails?
rationale: The branch makes this sequence intentional to solve the Control UI presentation problem, but choosing its cross-client terminal semantics is a product and protocol compatibility decision rather than a safe local UI-only refactor.

options.title: Approve the dual-outcome contract
options.body: Document and retain final assistant output plus a subsequent error terminal event, after confirming supported clients preserve both facts.

options.title: Use a distinct nonterminal failure signal
options.body: Keep one terminal run outcome and introduce a separately named event or payload for post-reply operational failure if maintainers want clients to retain a single-terminal-state invariant.

recommendation.title: Approve the dual-outcome contract
recommendation.body: Document and retain final assistant output plus a subsequent error terminal event, after confirming supported clients preserve both facts.
